title: Atlas launch go/no-go

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Okay, this is the go/no-go. Proposal on the table: Atlas GA on September 30. Let's go function by function.

transcript.speaker: jordan@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Engineering: fleet view, scheduling and staged OTA are done and in staging. 14 open bugs, none above medium. The one real risk is ATL-212.

transcript.speaker: devon@northwind.dev
transcript.text: SSO works, except KeyGate's metadata endpoint still serves a stale signing cert some of the time. Victor says their engineering team has reproduced it. No firm date yet.

transcript.speaker: elena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Can we launch without SSO and add it later?

transcript.speaker: omar@northwind.dev
transcript.text: For most customers, yes. For Globex, no. Dana's been explicit. No SSO, no rollout to their 120 robots. And their renewal is November 30.

transcript.speaker: lena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Four eighty in ARR. I'd really not have Atlas be the reason that renewal gets awkward.

transcript.speaker: raj@northwind.dev
transcript.text: So launch is effectively gated on ATL-212. How long do we need between it closing and GA?

transcript.speaker: devon@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Four days to regression test with real IdPs, Okta-style and Azure-style configs through KeyGate.

transcript.speaker: kai@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Design side, the SSO login UI is about 80 percent. Error states need work, especially the 'your admin hasn't set this up' screen.

transcript.speaker: ana@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Support is ready with Atlas macros. My bigger worry is firmware 2.8 Wi-Fi drops landing in the same week. Customers will blame Atlas for robots going offline.

transcript.speaker: raj@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Fair. 2.8.1 should be out before then. Different problem, but I hear you.

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: So proposal: GA on September 30, contingent on ATL-212 closing by September 26. If it doesn't close, we reconvene.

transcript.speaker: elena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: I'm a go on that, with the contingency. Devon, I want a real date from KeyGate, not 'soon'.

transcript.speaker: devon@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Understood. I'll push Victor for a committed date by Friday.

transcript.speaker: lena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Go, and I'll tell Globex the target but frame it as dependent on SSO.

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Great, decision recorded. I'll update the launch plan doc tomorrow.

summary: Go/no-go for Atlas GA. Core features are ready; the only blocker is ATL-212 (SAML SSO via KeyGate), which fails intermittently due to KeyGate's metadata endpoint serving a stale signing cert. Globex will not roll out to 120 robots without SSO and renews on 2026-11-30 ($480k ARR). The group approved GA on 2026-09-30, contingent on ATL-212 closing by 2026-09-26, with 4 days for regression testing.
decisions: Atlas GA on 2026-09-30, contingent on ATL-212 closing by 2026-09-26.

action_items.text: Get a firm date from KeyGate for the SAML metadata fix
